purpose: Close the autonomous social publication cadence bypass by making authenticated PostgreSQL OutboxEntry history, a transaction-scoped per-channel advisory lock and a signed marketing.publication-admission.v1 envelope the only durable admission authority.
requiredInvariants: Caller input cannot provide authoritative cadence history or authoritative now; only channel, editorial slot, content, idempotency and policy inputs are accepted.
The admission service loads bounded 30-day cadence history only from authenticated MARKETING_SOCIAL_PUBLISH_V2 PostgreSQL OutboxEntry rows in PENDING, PROCESSING, SENT or CONFIRMED state.
Pending and processing rows reserve a slot by createdAt; delivered rows consume a slot by sentAt; malformed, forged or unbound V2 history rows fail closed.
Admission decision, signed envelope creation and OutboxEntry insertion run in one Serializable Prisma transaction under a parameterized transaction-scoped PostgreSQL advisory lock per channel.
The deterministic planNextMarketingContent function remains the only cadence decision implementation.
Exact idempotent replay is accepted; reuse of an idempotency key for a different canonical command is refused.
MARKETING_PUBLICATION_ADMISSION_HMAC_SECRET must be present and strong before admission, enqueue or outbound worker dispatch can proceed.

The worker verifies HMAC, expiry, canonical request shape, content digest, command digest, authority digest and outbox idempotency binding, then reruns MarketingPolicyService before connector dispatch.
No raw MARKETING_SOCIAL_PUBLISH_V1 enqueue path remains callable.
No production, REG.RU, DNS, credentials, social-account, paid-mode or outbound mutation is authorized.
acceptance: Focused admission tests prove caller history and now rejection, PENDING reservation, SENT sentAt semantics, forged history rejection, cross-channel isolation, bounded history, advisory lock plus Serializable transaction use, exact replay, conflicting replay refusal and serialized empty-history reservations.
Focused policy and enqueue tests prove invalid INN, invalid ERID and missing evidence block before cadence reservation.
Focused publisher tests prove forged, expired and wrong-idempotency admissions are rejected before connector invocation.
The immutable marketing social growth workflow runs all new focused admission and anti-bypass tests.

API typecheck, web typecheck, isolated marketing worker build, marketing Jest tests, web attribution and intake tests, security tests, IP tests, action pinning and cryptographic inventory discovery are required gates.
Generated cryptographic inventory artifacts are refreshed from the exact authority base and remain derived evidence only.
